jobs.title: Corporate Security Officer - Flexible Shifts & Growth
jobs.description: United-Security-Inc in Dallas, TX is seeking a Full-Time Corporate Security Officer to ensure the safety of people and property. The role includes reception duties, badge checks, and monitoring access control, with shifts available Monday to Friday and competitive pay. The candidate should have a High School Diploma, Texas security license, and CPR certification, along with 1–5 years of security experience and strong customer-service skills.

jobs.title: Corporate Security Officer: Elite Protective Services
jobs.description: A leading real estate investment company in Dallas, TX is seeking a highly professional Security Officer for its in-house security team. The role involves providing protective services for the facility and personnel, monitoring security systems, and responding to emergencies. Candidates should possess strong situational awareness, communication skills, and a Texas Level 4 security certification. This organization values integrity and offers growth opportunities within its family of companies.
